verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design into a proper left-to-right banner: a two-line headline on the left and the CTA on the right, both vertically centred. Its flaws are a tight left margin (about 15px) and a fairly small CTA. B keeps a stacked, centred layout copied from the original. Its CTA sits only a few pixels from the bottom edge, the headline is jammed near the top, and wide empty side margins leave the layout looking shrunk rather than rearranged.
